about.heroBody: A student-driven interscholastic league built on competition, integrity, and varsity pride.
about.paragraph1: KC Varsity Association (KCVA) is a premier, student-driven interscholastic sports league dedicated to elevating high school athletics. Founded on the principles of fierce competition, integrity, and varsity pride, KCVA organizes professional-grade tournaments across Volleyball, Ultimate Frisbee, and emerging varsity disciplines for high schools and international programs.
about.paragraph2: Beyond the scoreboard, KCVA serves as an empowering platform for young student-athletes, organizers, and campus communities. By combining tournament standards, high-energy live atmospheres, and creative collaboration, we cultivate leadership, teamwork, and an enduring passion for sports that extends far beyond the court.

about.paragraph3: KCVA is more than a sports community. It is also a platform for international high school students across the Yangtze River Delta to connect, learn, and gain hands-on experience in business, event operations, sports culture, and photography.
